description: Returns annual named-executive compensation rows for a company identified by ticker or CIK, with fiscal-year filters, pay components, totals, and filing source URLs. Latest-FY requests cost 0 credits; historical, range, or multi-FY requests require OAuth or X-API-KEY and cost 1 credit. Pay ratio, pay-versus-performance, and company dossiers are not included. The result is filing data, not investment advice.

fiscal_year.description: Exact fiscal year. Omit all fiscal-year filters to get the latest year.

fiscal_year_gte.description: Inclusive earliest fiscal year. Omit all fiscal-year filters to get the latest year.

fiscal_year_lte.description: Inclusive latest fiscal year. Omit all fiscal-year filters to get the latest year.

limit.description: Maximum fiscal years to return. Defaults to the latest year only.

name: get_executive_compensation
title: Get Executive Compensation
